prediction_text: Yes — he shall be rich, and subsist of himself without dependence: wealth gotten by his own industry and trade, not by marriage. Mars, lord of the 2nd and lord of the Part of Fortune, in the Ascendant near Spica gives substance through his own labour and merchandising (martial commodities/trade); Jupiter exalted and angular near the 10th promises durable advancement; the 2nd cusp and the Part of Fortune both in fixed signs show the wealth, once come, continues. Timing (year-scale): the Moon wants 6°27' of her conjunction with Venus, lady of the Ascendant — full establishment of fortune after roughly six to seven years, increasing thereafter and continuing for life.
basis: 卡面未标注 tradition 字段，按题面体裁自决（Lilly horary）。systems_used: horary。已载面：致富否／何道致富／何时／能否久持四问逐面作答。断项过闸：致富←二宫主兼福点主火星入升近角宿一＋木星擢升居角近十宫；自力贸易致富←火星为二宫主而入升（财自其身出）；久持←二宫头与福点皆固定宫；应期尺度定年档（终身财福类），月亮距合金星6°27'取约六至七年为主坐标，冲实／填实／逢值三路中以逢值（成相度数）取点，余路无候选。对象核：承受与应验同为求问者本人。
